newsitem.title: USA: Knickerbocker to acquire jewelry maker.
newsitem.headline: Knickerbocker to acquire jewelry maker.

text.p: L.L. Knickerbocker Co Inc said Wednesday it plans to acquire Bangkok, Thailand-based jewelry maker Harlyn International Co Ltd, a unit of Harlyn Products Inc.
It said the acquisition would be made for cash and would include debt assumption. Further financial details were not disclosed.
Harlyn International will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of L.L. Knickerbocker.
Harlyn International currently generates annual sales of about $10 million by making and marketing gold, diamond and emerald jewelry.
Harlyn International focuses primarily on Western Europe and South America, but L.L. Knickerbocker plan to expand sales worldwide.
Currently, sales in L.L. Knickerbocker's jewelry operation in Thailand and the United States total about $30 million annually.
"We are aggressively building L.L. Knickerbocker into a major jewelry manufacturing, marketing and sales distribution company," Louis Knickerbocker, chief executive, said in a statement.
